title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S4 E4 — Jailhouse Blues
Before any inmate sees the inside of a prison, he has most likely first seen the inside of a jail; nothing about jail is for the faint of heart; for some, jail is the ultimate limbo between freedom and a life behind bars or even worse.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S2 E4 — The Money Mules; Sweet Stink of Success
Mysterious hackers enlist the help of students in New York to pull off a massive cyber-crime heist; a one-time California golden boy accused of luring investors with outrageous investment promises.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S2 E5 — Hard-Rocking Fraudster; Refi's in Ruin
A concert promoter flees when the SEC accuses him of investment fraud; a man steals millions perpetrating lending and mortgage scams across the country.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S2 E6 — Diamonds Aren't Forever; Cover Your Assets
A real estate developer with a sterling reputation ends up in bankruptcy court; a CEO is charged with overseeing accounting fraud to inflate his company's worth to investors while pocketing a fortune.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E20 — Top Gun of Fraud
A man purchases items such as real estate, boats, and vintage aircraft after stealing over $50 million from a trust fund.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E16 — Wine, Women and Fraud
A man steals millions from rich wine clients, and spends the money on fast cars and faster hookups, until he himself falls prey to a scheme.

title: American Greed
description:
S4 E5 — Crash and Burn
Marcus Schrenker makes millions; he's a Wall Street money manager and a stunt pilot; but clients say he's a con man who had the country wondering for days whether he was dead or alive.

title: American Greed
description:
S4 E8 — Flipping Frenzy Scam
Would-be marketing mogul Jeanetta Standefor relies on investor trust and faith when she convinces clients that their cash is rescuing homeowners from foreclosure.

title: American Greed
description:
S4 E11 — Cutting Profits: Necessary Surgeries; Government Contractors Steal Millions
Government contractors steal millions; dermatologist performs unsanitary and unnecessary procedures.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E38 — 38 - Financial Guru Gone Bad
An "asset protection" guru steals millions from the famous, elderly and sick; he makes money disappear in a Ponzi scheme.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E12 — The Lady Killer
A Florida man wins millions in the lottery then disappears.
